info.name: Zluri Data Upload Syncs API
info.description:
The Zluri API provides external endpoints for integrating with the Zluri SaaS management platform. It enables organizations to push data from custom and on-premise applications to Zluri when no native connector is available. The API supports syncing users, applications, contracts, transactions, groups, roles, and activities. It follows a sync-based workflow where you create a sync session, upload data in paginated batches, and finish the sync to make data visible in Zluri. The API also supports webhook management for real-time notifications and instance configuration management.

Contact Support:
